caption:
Make, do or take? 🤔 These 5 traps catch almost every intermediate learner.

Which one did you get wrong? Be honest 👇 Save it for later 📌

#learnenglish #englishvocabulary #collocations #englishmistakes #esl

slides.tip: *make* a mistake · a decision · a plan

slides.wrong: Can you make a photo of us?
slides.right: Can you *take* a photo of us?
slides.tip: *take* a photo · a shower · a break

slides.wrong: I have to make my homework
Can you borrow me your charger?

slides.title: Use them in real conversations with *Lupa* 🎙️
